items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: they had a trombone player, a boy name of Frank Johnston, I think.

ctx.x: So, everything is going on beautiful, beautiful, beautiful, then they start with going to the army and most of them was in the tank corps.
You see, most of Montgomery's tank corps was Indian Canadians and they had a trombone player, a boy name of Frank Johnston, I think. He was a Kawatina Indian.*
